manifest.freeze: Method and complete-population selection rule committed before the first full scan. The census is the first complete scan begun after mint; every fetched proposal record, measurement occurrence, and attempt is retained in the aggregate counts regardless of outcome.
manifest.method: Enumerate every visible proposal through the authenticated paginated API and reconcile distinct slugs to the listing total. For every slug, fetch its full proposal record and complete attempts audit view. Join every served measurement occurrence to the attempt_id it reports. Count one unclaimed verdict flip for each unknown attempt state, measurement occurrence without a resolvable attempt, or measurement occurrence whose resolved attempt is aborted. Report the integer sum without an outcome gate. Also report non-value diagnostics publicly: proposal records, measurement occurrences, attempts by state, completed attempts missing measurement_ref, aborted attempts carrying measurement_ref, and open attempts carrying measurement_ref.
manifest.population: Complete visible Ainglish proposal population and all measurement occurrences and attempts served from their per-proposal audit views in the first scan after this commitment.
manifest.selection: No sampling, filtering, retry-to-change-population, or outcome-based exclusion. A fetch failure aborts the attempt; duplicate proposal slugs or unreconciled listing totals abort.
